title: 光學薄膜干涉鍍膜~Optical interference coatings
focus: 以特徵矩陣與導納把多層膜設計、材料、沉積監控與光譜驗證連成可交付的鍍膜工程~Linking multilayer design, materials, deposition monitoring and spectral verification through the characteristic matrix and admittance into deliverable coating engineering
summary: 從單層膜的 Fresnel 振幅相加出發，用特徵矩陣與導納轉換推導四分之一波堆的反射率與阻帶寬度，再討論氧化物與氟化物材料、蒸鍍與濺鍍的微結構差異、石英晶體與光學監控、分光光度驗證與逆向工程、入射角與環境造成的光譜位移，直到均勻性夾具、環境測試與驗收交接。~Beginning with Fresnel amplitudes adding in a single film, derive quarter-wave-stack reflectance and stop-band width with the characteristic matrix and admittance transformation, then cover oxide and fluoride materials, the microstructural difference between evaporated and sputtered films, quartz-crystal and optical monitoring, spectrophotometric verification and reverse engineering, spectral shifts with incidence angle and environment, and finally uniformity fixtures, environmental testing and acceptance handoff.

units.anchor: 單層膜的兩個界面~The two interfaces of a single film
units.title: 單層膜干涉與 Fresnel 振幅相加~Single-film interference and Fresnel amplitude addition
units.mechanism: 一層厚度 d、折射率 n₁ 的透明薄膜有兩個界面，各自依 Fresnel 公式反射一部分振幅；兩束反射光的相位差由光程 2n₁d·cosθ 決定，彼此可以相消或相加。當光學厚度 n₁d 等於四分之一波長時，兩個界面的反射相位相反，若 n₁ 介於入射介質與基板之間反射率下降，若 n₁ 高於基板反射率反而上升；光學厚度為半波時薄膜「隱形」，反射率回到裸基板值。這個單層結果是所有干涉鍍膜的基本單元，也說明為何同一層膜在不同波長下行為完全不同。~A transparent film of thickness d and index n₁ has two interfaces, each reflecting part of the amplitude according to the Fresnel equations; the phase difference between the two reflected waves is set by the path 2n₁d·cosθ, so they can cancel or reinforce. When the optical thickness n₁d equals a quarter wavelength the two reflections are in antiphase: reflectance drops if n₁ lies between the incident medium and substrate, but rises if n₁ exceeds the substrate index; at half-wave thickness the film is absentee and reflectance returns to the bare-substrate value. This single-layer result is the basic unit of every interference coating and shows why one film behaves completely differently at different wavelengths.
units.model: 四分之一波單層在正向入射的反射率 R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]²。TiO₂（n₁ = 2.35）鍍在 BK7（n_s = 1.52）上：R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323，由裸玻璃的 4.3% 升到 32%；同一層在半波波長（設計波長的一半）時 R 回到 4.3%。相位厚度 δ = 2πn₁d/λ，550 nm 的四分之一波 TiO₂ 厚度 d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm。~A quarter-wave single layer at normal incidence reflects R = [(n₀n_s − n₁²)/(n₀n_s + n₁²)]². For TiO₂ (n₁ = 2.35) on BK7 (n_s = 1.52): R = [(1.52 − 5.52)/(1.52 + 5.52)]² = (−4.00/7.04)² ≈ 0.323, up from 4.3% for bare glass to 32%; at the half-wave wavelength (half the design wavelength) R returns to 4.3%. The phase thickness is δ = 2πn₁d/λ, so a quarter-wave TiO₂ layer for 550 nm has d = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm.
units.verify: 鍍一層在 1100 nm 為四分之一波的 TiO₂（d ≈ 117 nm）於 BK7 基板，用分光光度計量反射率光譜，確認在 1100 nm 附近出現約 32% 的極大值，而在 550 nm 附近的半波點回到裸基板的 4.3%；用橢偏儀量出 n₁ 與 d，把量到的極值波長與 4n₁d 比較。~Deposit one TiO₂ layer that is a quarter wave at 1100 nm (d ≈ 117 nm) on BK7 and record the reflectance spectrum with a spectrophotometer, confirming a maximum near 32% around 1100 nm and a return to the bare-substrate 4.3% at the half-wave point near 550 nm; measure n₁ and d by ellipsometry and compare the measured extremum wavelength with 4n₁d.
units.failure: 把高折射率單層誤當成增透膜鍍在透鏡上，反射率反而由 4% 升到 30%，整組鏡頭的穿透率與鬼影同時惡化。~Depositing a high-index single layer as if it were an antireflection film raises reflectance from 4% to 30%, degrading lens transmission and ghost images together.
units.misconception: 任何薄膜只要夠薄就能降低玻璃的反射率。~Any film thin enough reduces the reflectance of glass.

units.anchor: 四分之一波堆與導納~Quarter-wave stack and admittance
units.title: 特徵矩陣、導納轉換與四分之一波堆~Characteristic matrix, admittance transformation and the quarter-wave stack
units.mechanism: 多層膜用每層的 2×2 特徵矩陣連乘來計算，矩陣元素只含該層的折射率與相位厚度，整個膜系在入射側呈現一個等效導納 Y，反射率就是 [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]²。四分之一波層的矩陣特別簡單：它把後方的導納 Y 轉成 n²/Y，所以高低折射率交替的 (HL)ᴺ 堆每加一對就把導納乘上 (n_H/n_L)²，反射率隨對數迅速逼近 1。阻帶寬度只由折射率比決定，與層數無關；層數只決定阻帶內的反射率深度與帶邊陡度。~A multilayer is computed by multiplying the 2×2 characteristic matrix of each layer, whose elements contain only that layer's index and phase thickness; the whole stack presents an equivalent admittance Y on the incident side, and reflectance is [(n₀ − Y)/(n₀ + Y)]². A quarter-wave layer has an especially simple matrix: it transforms the admittance behind it, Y, into n²/Y, so each added pair of an alternating (HL)ᴺ stack multiplies the admittance by (n_H/n_L)² and reflectance approaches 1 rapidly with pair count. The stop-band width depends only on the index ratio, not on the layer count; the count sets only the reflectance depth inside the band and the edge steepness.
units.model: Glass | (HL)ᴺ | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s。TiO₂/SiO₂（2.35/1.46）、N = 10 對、n_s = 1.52：(2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴，Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴，R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998。阻帶半寬 Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150，設計波長 550 nm 的阻帶約從 478 nm 延伸到 647 nm。~For glass | (HL)ᴺ | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_s. With TiO₂/SiO₂ (2.35/1.46), N = 10 pairs and n_s = 1.52: (2.35/1.46)²⁰ = e^{20×0.476} ≈ 1.37×10⁴, Y ≈ 2.08×10⁴, R = [(Y − 1)/(Y + 1)]² ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998. The stop-band half-width Δg = (2/π)·arcsin[(n_H − n_L)/(n_H + n_L)] = (2/π)·arcsin(0.234) ≈ 0.150, so a 550 nm design has a stop band from about 478 nm to 647 nm.
units.verify: 用薄膜設計軟體或自行寫的矩陣程式計算 (HL)¹⁰ 的光譜，核對阻帶中心反射率與帶邊位置是否與導納公式一致；再量測實鍍樣品的反射率，比較阻帶寬度（應只隨折射率比變化）與帶內漣波（反映厚度誤差）。~Compute the (HL)¹⁰ spectrum with thin-film software or your own matrix code and check that the central reflectance and band edges agree with the admittance formulas; then measure a deposited sample and compare the stop-band width, which should depend only on index ratio, and the in-band ripple, which reflects thickness errors.
units.failure: 為了拓寬阻帶一味增加層數，寬度毫無改善而膜厚與應力倍增，基板彎曲且膜層開裂；正確做法是提高折射率比或堆疊不同中心波長的子堆。~Adding layers to widen a stop band leaves the width unchanged while doubling thickness and stress, bending the substrate and cracking the film; the correct approach is a higher index ratio or stacked sub-stacks with different centre wavelengths.
units.misconception: 層數越多，高反射膜的反射波段就越寬。~More layers make a high-reflector's reflection band wider.

units.anchor: 氧化物與氟化物膜材~Oxide and fluoride film materials
units.title: 膜材選擇、吸收邊與堆積密度~Material choice, absorption edge and packing density
units.mechanism: 可見與近紅外鍍膜以氧化物為主：SiO₂（1.46）作低折射率層，Al₂O₃（1.63）、HfO₂（1.95）、Ta₂O₅（2.10）、Nb₂O₅（2.30）與 TiO₂（2.35）作高折射率層；紫外區要避開 TiO₂ 與 Ta₂O₅ 的吸收邊，改用 HfO₂ 或氟化物如 MgF₂（1.38）與 LaF₃；紅外區則用 ZnS、Ge、YbF₃。材料選擇同時受吸收係數、應力、硬度與與基板的附著力限制。蒸鍍膜常呈柱狀多孔結構，堆積密度 0.8 到 0.9，孔隙吸水後折射率上升、光譜紅移；離子輔助或濺鍍能把密度推近 1，光譜才能穩定。~Visible and near-infrared coatings rely mainly on oxides: SiO₂ (1.46) as the low-index layer and Al₂O₃ (1.63), HfO₂ (1.95), Ta₂O₅ (2.10), Nb₂O₅ (2.30) or TiO₂ (2.35) as high-index layers; in the ultraviolet the absorption edges of TiO₂ and Ta₂O₅ must be avoided in favour of HfO₂ or fluorides such as MgF₂ (1.38) and LaF₃, while the infrared uses ZnS, Ge and YbF₃. The choice is also bounded by absorption coefficient, stress, hardness and adhesion to the substrate. Evaporated films are often columnar and porous with packing density 0.8 to 0.9; water filling the pores raises the index and red-shifts the spectrum, and only ion assistance or sputtering pushes density toward 1 so the spectrum stays stable.
units.model: 線性混合估計（教學假設）：堆積密度 p = 0.85 的 TiO₂ 膜，乾燥時 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275，孔隙吸水後 n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325，光學厚度變化 Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2%，550 nm 的設計波長紅移約 12 nm；若 p = 0.98，同樣計算只得 0.3%，約 1.6 nm。~Linear-mixing estimate (teaching assumption): a TiO₂ film with packing density p = 0.85 has n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.00 = 2.275 when dry and n ≈ 0.85×2.50 + 0.15×1.33 = 2.325 when water fills the pores, so the optical thickness changes by Δ(nd)/nd = 0.050/2.275 ≈ 2.2% and a 550 nm design red-shifts by about 12 nm; at p = 0.98 the same calculation gives only 0.3%, about 1.6 nm.
units.verify: 把樣品在乾燥氮氣與 90% 相對濕度之間切換，連續量光譜，記錄特徵波長的位移與恢復時間，反推堆積密度；用橢偏儀量各材料的 n、k 光譜，確認在工作波段 k 低於 10⁻⁴ 並記錄吸收邊位置。~Cycle the sample between dry nitrogen and 90% relative humidity while recording spectra, note the shift and recovery time of a feature wavelength, and infer packing density; measure n and k spectra of each material by ellipsometry to confirm k below 10⁻⁴ in the working band and record the absorption-edge position.
units.failure: 用 TiO₂ 設計 350 nm 紫外濾光片，膜層在工作波段強烈吸收，穿透率只剩設計值的一半且雷射照射下升溫脫落；蒸鍍多孔膜出廠光譜合格，裝機後因吸濕紅移 10 nm 而失效。~Designing a 350 nm ultraviolet filter with TiO₂ puts the working band inside its absorption, halving transmission and causing heating and delamination under laser exposure; a porous evaporated filter that passed at shipment fails after installation when humidity red-shifts it by 10 nm.
units.misconception: 薄膜的折射率就是同一材料的塊材折射率。~A thin film has the same refractive index as the bulk material.

units.anchor: 蒸鍍與濺鍍源、石英晶體監控~Evaporation and sputter sources, quartz-crystal monitor
units.title: 沉積製程與厚度監控~Deposition processes and thickness monitoring
units.mechanism: 電子束蒸鍍的原子到達能量只有約 0.1 eV，形成柱狀多孔膜，加上離子輔助（IAD）能把密度提高；磁控濺鍍與離子束濺鍍（IBS）的到達能量為數 eV 到數十 eV，膜層緻密、非晶且損耗最低，但 IBS 速率僅約 0.1 nm/s；原子層沉積以自限反應逐層生長，共形性最好但更慢。厚度監控有兩類：石英晶體微天平依 Sauerbrey 關係把質量變化轉成頻率變化，需要校正「工具因子」把晶體位置換算到基板位置；光學監控直接看監控片在控制波長的穿透或反射率，在四分之一波轉折點停止，具有自我補償誤差的特性。~Electron-beam evaporation delivers adatoms with only about 0.1 eV, producing columnar porous films, and ion-assisted deposition raises their density; magnetron and ion-beam sputtering arrive with several to tens of eV, giving dense amorphous films with the lowest loss, though IBS runs at only about 0.1 nm/s; atomic layer deposition grows self-limiting monolayers with the best conformality but is slower still. Thickness monitoring comes in two kinds: a quartz-crystal microbalance converts mass change into frequency change through the Sauerbrey relation and needs a calibrated tooling factor to map crystal position to substrate position, while optical monitoring watches the transmittance or reflectance of a witness at a control wavelength and stops at the quarter-wave turning point, which self-compensates thickness errors.
units.model: Sauerbrey：Δf = −C_f·Δm/A，5 MHz AT 切晶體 C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg。鍍 100 nm 的 SiO₂（ρ = 2.2 g/cm³）面密度 Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm²，Δf ≈ −1245 Hz；頻率解析度 0.1 Hz 對應約 0.008 nm，但工具因子若誤差 2%，100 nm 層就偏 2 nm。IBS 以 0.1 nm/s 沉積 1.5 µm 的 19 層堆需約 4.2 h。~Sauerbrey: Δf = −C_f·Δm/A with C_f ≈ 56.6 Hz·cm²/µg for a 5 MHz AT-cut crystal. Depositing 100 nm of SiO₂ (ρ = 2.2 g/cm³) adds Δm/A = 2.2 g/cm³ × 10⁻⁵ cm = 22 µg/cm², so Δf ≈ −1245 Hz; a 0.1 Hz resolution corresponds to about 0.008 nm, but a 2% tooling-factor error puts a 100 nm layer off by 2 nm. Depositing a 1.5 µm, 19-layer stack by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes about 4.2 h.
units.verify: 鍍單層試片並以橢偏儀或台階儀量實際厚度，與石英晶體讀值之比即為工具因子，每次更換源材或夾具後重做；用光學監控記錄穿透率隨時間的曲線，確認轉折點清晰且在預期時間出現，並比較兩種監控給出的厚度差異。~Deposit a single-layer witness, measure its real thickness by ellipsometry or stylus profilometry, and take the ratio to the crystal reading as the tooling factor, repeating after any change of source material or fixture; record the optical-monitor transmittance trace against time, confirm the turning point is sharp and arrives when expected, and compare the thicknesses implied by the two monitors.
units.failure: 石英晶體壽命將盡時頻率跳動，監控把假訊號當成沉積量提前關閉快門，該層薄了 5%，整個濾光片的通帶偏移到規格之外；蒸鍍腔未加離子輔助，出廠合格的濾光片在濕季全部紅移。~A crystal near end of life jitters in frequency, the monitor reads the glitch as deposition and closes the shutter early, the layer is 5% thin and the filter passband shifts out of specification; an evaporation chamber without ion assistance ships filters that all red-shift in the humid season.
units.misconception: 石英晶體監控讀到的厚度就是基板上的厚度。~The thickness read by the quartz-crystal monitor is the thickness on the substrate.

units.anchor: 分光光度計與逆向工程~Spectrophotometer and reverse engineering
units.title: 光譜驗證、逆向工程與損耗分解~Spectral verification, reverse engineering and loss decomposition
units.mechanism: 鍍膜完成後用分光光度計量穿透率與反射率光譜，絕對精度約 0.1% 到 0.3%，再與設計曲線比對；差異可用逆向工程把各層厚度與折射率當成未知數擬合，找出是哪一層、哪一種誤差造成偏移。損耗以 1 − R − T 分解成吸收與散射，吸收由光熱或光腔衰盪法量到 ppm 等級，散射由總積分散射儀取得。對窄帶濾光片，中心波長對光學厚度極度敏感，所以驗證必須同時說明量測的波長準確度與光束發散角。~After deposition the transmittance and reflectance spectra are measured on a spectrophotometer with an absolute accuracy of about 0.1% to 0.3% and compared with the design curve; the difference is fitted by reverse engineering, treating layer thicknesses and indices as unknowns, to find which layer and which error type caused the deviation. Loss is decomposed as 1 − R − T into absorption and scatter, absorption measured to ppm by photothermal or cavity ring-down methods and scatter by total-integrated-scatter instruments. For narrowband filters the centre wavelength is extremely sensitive to optical thickness, so verification must state the wavelength accuracy and beam divergence of the measurement.
units.model: 光譜位移與光學厚度成正比：Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd)。全膜厚度一致偏 1%，550 nm 設計位移 5.5 nm；1550 nm 的 DWDM 濾光片 FWHM 1 nm，0.1% 的厚度誤差已造成 1.55 nm 位移，所以必須控制到 0.01%（0.15 nm）等級，這就是 IBS 配合光學監控的理由。損耗分解：R = 99.95%、T = 0.03% 時 A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm。~Spectral shift is proportional to optical thickness: Δλ/λ = Δ(nd)/(nd). A uniform 1% thickness error shifts a 550 nm design by 5.5 nm; for a 1550 nm DWDM filter with 1 nm FWHM, a 0.1% error already shifts it 1.55 nm, so control must reach the 0.01% (0.15 nm) level, which is why IBS with optical monitoring is used. Loss decomposition: with R = 99.95% and T = 0.03%, A + S = 0.02% = 200 ppm.
units.verify: 先用 NIST 可追溯的標準濾光片校正分光光度計的波長與光度刻度，再量樣品；逆向工程擬合後，把擬合得到的厚度誤差與石英晶體或光學監控的運行紀錄對照，確認兩者指向同一層；對高反射樣品另以光腔衰盪量 1 − R 以避免 0.1% 級光度誤差淹沒結果。~Calibrate the spectrophotometer's wavelength and photometric scales with NIST-traceable reference filters before measuring; after the reverse-engineering fit, compare the fitted thickness errors with the crystal or optical-monitor run log to confirm both point to the same layer; for high reflectors measure 1 − R by cavity ring-down so that 0.1%-level photometric error does not swamp the result.
units.failure: 用發散角 3° 的光束量窄帶濾光片，有效入射角使通帶變寬且中心藍移，合格品被誤判為不合格；或只量穿透率不量反射率，把吸收當成散射去追查粗糙度，方向完全錯誤。~Measuring a narrowband filter with a 3° divergent beam broadens the passband and blue-shifts it through the effective incidence angle, rejecting good parts; measuring transmission only and attributing the missing light to scatter sends the investigation after roughness when the real cause is absorption.
units.misconception: 分光光度計曲線與設計重疊就代表每一層厚度都正確。~A spectrophotometer curve matching the design proves every layer thickness is correct.

units.anchor: 入射角與偏振造成的光譜位移~Angle- and polarization-induced spectral shift
units.title: 入射角、偏振與公差預算~Incidence angle, polarization and tolerance budget
units.mechanism: 薄膜的相位厚度含 cosθ 因子，入射角增加時每層的有效光學厚度變小，整個光譜向短波移動；位移量由一個等效折射率決定，高折射率膜系位移較小。斜入射時 s 與 p 偏振的 Fresnel 係數不同，阻帶寬度與帶邊位置分裂，45° 的分光鏡必須分別對兩個偏振設計。公差預算把厚度、折射率、均勻性與入射角誤差各自換算成波長位移，以均方根相加，再與規格的帶邊容差比較，決定哪一項必須被製程或量測收緊。~The phase thickness of a film carries a cosθ factor, so as incidence angle grows every layer's effective optical thickness shrinks and the whole spectrum moves to shorter wavelengths; the shift is governed by an effective index, with high-index stacks shifting less. At oblique incidence the s and p Fresnel coefficients differ, so stop-band width and edge positions split, and a 45° beam splitter must be designed for each polarization separately. The tolerance budget converts thickness, index, uniformity and angle errors into wavelength shifts, adds them root-sum-square and compares the total with the specified edge tolerance to decide which term the process or metrology must tighten.
units.model: λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²)。取 n_eff = 1.85（TiO₂/SiO₂ 幾何平均）：θ = 10° 時位移 −0.44%，550 nm 設計移 −2.4 nm；θ = 45° 時 √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924，位移 −7.6%，約 −42 nm。帶邊公差 ±1%（±5.5 nm）的預算：厚度 0.5%、折射率 0.3%、均勻性 0.3%、入射角 ±2°（在 45° 附近約 0.5%），RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%，尚有餘裕。~λ(θ) ≈ λ₀·√(1 − sin²θ/n_eff²). With n_eff = 1.85 (the TiO₂/SiO₂ geometric mean): at θ = 10° the shift is −0.44%, −2.4 nm for a 550 nm design; at 45°, √(1 − 0.5/3.42) ≈ 0.924, a −7.6% shift of about −42 nm. For an edge tolerance of ±1% (±5.5 nm) the budget of thickness 0.5%, index 0.3%, uniformity 0.3% and angle ±2° (about 0.5% near 45°) gives RSS = √(0.5² + 0.3² + 0.3² + 0.5²) ≈ 0.83%, still within margin.
units.verify: 在分光光度計上以 0°、10°、30°、45° 量同一樣品並分別用 s、p 偏振片，記錄帶邊波長，與 λ(θ) 公式擬合求出 n_eff；把量到的批內位移分佈與公差預算的 RSS 比較，若實測分佈更寬，逐項找出被低估的來源。~Measure the same sample at 0°, 10°, 30° and 45° with s and p polarizers on the spectrophotometer, record the edge wavelengths and fit λ(θ) to extract n_eff; compare the measured within-batch shift distribution with the budget's RSS and, if the real spread is wider, locate the underestimated term one by one.
units.failure: 在 0° 設計並驗證的濾光片被裝在 20° 收斂光束中，中心藍移 1.7% 且通帶因角度範圍而變寬，系統訊噪比下降；45° 分光鏡只對平均偏振設計，s 與 p 的分光比差了 20%，偏振相關損耗超標。~A filter designed and verified at 0° installed in a 20° converging beam blue-shifts by 1.7% and broadens with the angle range, lowering system signal-to-noise; a 45° splitter designed for average polarization splits s and p 20% apart and fails polarization-dependent loss.
units.misconception: 鍍膜的光譜性能與入射角無關，只要在正向量測合格即可。~Coating performance is independent of incidence angle, so passing at normal incidence is enough.

units.anchor: 行星轉架、均勻性遮罩與環境測試~Planetary fixture, uniformity mask and environmental tests
units.title: 均勻性夾具、見證片與環境耐久~Uniformity fixtures, witness samples and environmental durability
units.mechanism: 鍍膜腔內的沉積速率隨位置變化：點狀蒸發源向上方平面沉積的厚度隨離軸距離下降，因此基板放在旋轉的行星轉架上並加上修正遮罩，把全批的厚度差壓到 0.5% 以內；濺鍍系統則靠靶材與基板幾何及公轉達到相同目的。每一批放入與產品同材料的見證片，用於光譜、附著與環境測試。環境耐久依 ISO 9211 或軍規序列進行：濕熱、鹽霧、溫度循環、膠帶附著與橡皮擦磨耗，確認膜層不會起泡、龜裂或脫落。~Deposition rate inside a chamber varies with position: a point-like evaporation source coats a plane above it with thickness falling off-axis, so substrates ride on a rotating planetary fixture with correction masks to hold the batch thickness spread within 0.5%, while sputtering systems reach the same goal through target-substrate geometry and planetary motion. Each batch carries witness samples of the same material as the product for spectral, adhesion and environmental tests. Durability follows ISO 9211 or military-specification sequences: humidity, salt fog, temperature cycling, tape adhesion and eraser abrasion, confirming that the film neither blisters, cracks nor delaminates.
units.model: 面蒸發源對正上方平面的厚度分佈 t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]²。源到基板 h = 600 mm，離軸 r = 150 mm：(1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129，厚度只有中心的 88.6%，即 11.4% 的落差；加上行星公轉與遮罩後，批內殘差可壓到 ±0.3%。環境測試後允許的光譜位移若為 ±0.5%，依第三單元的線性混合估計就要求堆積密度高於約 0.97。~A surface evaporation source coats the plane above it with t(r)/t(0) = 1/[1 + (r/h)²]². For a source-to-substrate height h = 600 mm and off-axis radius r = 150 mm, (1 + 0.0625)² ≈ 1.129, so the thickness is only 88.6% of centre, an 11.4% fall-off; planetary rotation plus masking brings the within-batch residual to ±0.3%. If the allowed spectral shift after environmental testing is ±0.5%, the linear-mixing estimate of unit 3 requires a packing density above about 0.97.
units.verify: 在轉架不同半徑放置見證片，量各片的特徵波長並換算厚度分佈，與幾何公式及遮罩設計比較；環境測試前後各量一次光譜，比較位移是否在允許範圍，並以顯微鏡檢查膠帶與磨耗測試後的膜面是否完整。~Place witness samples at several radii on the fixture, measure each one's feature wavelength and convert to a thickness distribution to compare with the geometric formula and mask design; record spectra before and after environmental testing to confirm the shift stays within allowance, and inspect the film under a microscope after tape and abrasion tests for integrity.
units.failure: 修正遮罩被膜材堆積後形狀改變，批內厚度差從 0.3% 漲到 2%，同一批濾光片的中心波長散佈超出規格；基板清洗不良導致附著力不足，鹽霧測試後膜層成片剝落。~A correction mask whose shape has changed under accumulated deposit lets the batch thickness spread grow from 0.3% to 2%, scattering the centre wavelengths of one batch outside specification; poor substrate cleaning gives weak adhesion and the film peels in sheets after salt-fog testing.
units.misconception: 同一爐鍍出來的所有基板，膜層一定完全相同。~Every substrate from the same coating run carries an identical film.

units.anchor: 鍍膜規格表與批次追溯紀錄~Coating specification sheet and batch-traceability record
units.title: 規格書、保護帶與工程交接~Specification sheet, guard band and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 鍍膜規格必須同時指定波段、入射角範圍、偏振、基板材料、穿透或反射的平均值與極值，以及環境等級與（若適用）雷射損傷門檻；缺少任一項，驗收就沒有依據。因為量測有不確定度，驗收必須設保護帶：量測值必須比規格好於量測不確定度的範圍才能判定合格。交接資料包含設計層結構摘要（不含製程配方）、見證片光譜、逆向工程結果、均勻性分佈、環境測試報告與批次編號，讓系統整合端能追溯每片元件的鍍膜狀態。~A coating specification must state band, incidence-angle range, polarization, substrate material, average and extreme transmittance or reflectance, environmental class and, where relevant, laser-damage threshold; missing any item leaves acceptance without a basis. Because measurements carry uncertainty, acceptance needs a guard band: the measured value must beat the specification by the measurement uncertainty before a pass is declared. The handoff package holds a design summary of the layer structure (not the process recipe), witness spectra, reverse-engineering results, uniformity map, environmental test report and batch numbers so the system integrator can trace each element's coating state.
units.model: 規格：450 到 650 nm 平均 T > 95%，分光光度計不確定度 ±0.2%，則保護帶後的判定門檻為 95.2%。製程能力：帶邊規格 ±1.5%，製程位移標準差 σ = 0.33%（±1% 為 3σ），C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5，預期良率約 99.99%；若 σ 升到 0.5%，C_pk = 1.0，良率約 99.7%，每千片有 3 片超規。~Specification: average T > 95% from 450 to 650 nm with spectrophotometer uncertainty ±0.2%, so the guard-banded pass threshold is 95.2%. Process capability: edge specification ±1.5% with a process shift standard deviation σ = 0.33% (±1% as 3σ) gives C_pk = 1.5/(3×0.33) ≈ 1.5 and an expected yield of about 99.99%; if σ rises to 0.5%, C_pk = 1.0 and yield about 99.7%, three parts per thousand out of specification.
units.verify: 抽樣以第二台經校正的分光光度計複測，差異需小於保護帶的一半；檢查規格表的每一項是否都有對應的量測紀錄與條件（角度、偏振、溫濕度）；以歷史批次的位移分佈計算實際 C_pk，與承諾的良率對照。~Re-measure a sample on a second calibrated spectrophotometer, requiring agreement within half the guard band; check that every specification line has a matching measurement record with conditions (angle, polarization, temperature and humidity); compute the real C_pk from historical batch shifts and compare it with the promised yield.
units.failure: 規格只寫「穿透率大於 95%」而未指定波段與角度，供應商在 550 nm 正向合格，客戶在 480 nm、15° 下使用而穿透率只有 90%，雙方各執一詞；沒有批次編號，現場失效的濾光片無法回溯到同爐的見證片。~A specification reading only transmittance above 95% without band or angle passes at 550 nm normal incidence while the customer uses it at 480 nm and 15° with 90% transmission, leaving both sides arguing; without batch numbers a field failure cannot be traced back to its witness samples.
units.misconception: 鍍膜規格只需要一個目標穿透率數字。~A coating specification needs only a single target transmittance number.

example: 四分之一波堆練習：設計 550 nm 的 TiO₂/SiO₂ 高反射膜 Glass | (HL)⁹H | air，n_H = 2.35、n_L = 1.46、n_s = 1.52。各層厚度 d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm、d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm，19 層總厚度 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm。導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴，R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998（無吸收時）。阻帶半寬 Δg ≈ 0.150，阻帶約 478 到 647 nm。若整批厚度一致偏厚 1%，整個光譜紅移 5.5 nm；以 10° 入射使用時藍移 0.44%（2.4 nm），兩者部分抵消。以 IBS 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h；石英晶體監控一層 94.2 nm 的 SiO₂ 對應 Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz。數值為教學假設，不代表任何鍍膜廠的設計或製程。~Quarter-wave-stack exercise: design a 550 nm TiO₂/SiO₂ high reflector Glass | (HL)⁹H | air with n_H = 2.35, n_L = 1.46 and n_s = 1.52. Layer thicknesses are d_H = 550/(4×2.35) ≈ 58.5 nm and d_L = 550/(4×1.46) ≈ 94.2 nm, a 19-layer total of 10×58.5 + 9×94.2 ≈ 1433 nm. The admittance Y = (n_H/n_L)¹⁸·n_H²/n_s = e^{18×0.476} × 5.52/1.52 ≈ 5.27×10³ × 3.63 ≈ 1.92×10⁴, so R ≈ 1 − 4/Y ≈ 0.9998 without absorption. The stop-band half-width Δg ≈ 0.150 gives a band from about 478 to 647 nm. A uniform 1% thickness excess red-shifts the whole spectrum by 5.5 nm, while use at 10° incidence blue-shifts it by 0.44% (2.4 nm), partly cancelling. Depositing by IBS at 0.1 nm/s takes 1433/0.1 ≈ 14,300 s ≈ 4.0 h; one 94.2 nm SiO₂ layer on the quartz-crystal monitor corresponds to Δf ≈ 56.6 × 2.2 × 9.42 ≈ 1173 Hz. Values are teaching assumptions, not any coating shop's design or process.
history: 1817 年 Fraunhofer 注意到表面風化的玻璃反射較弱，1886 年 Rayleigh 以漸變折射率解釋；1935 年蔡司的 Alexander Smakula 取得真空蒸鍍增透膜專利，1946 年 Max Auwärter 在列支敦斯登創立 Balzers，把真空鍍膜變成產業。Angus Macleod 於 1969 年出版的《Thin-Film Optical Filters》確立了特徵矩陣與導納圖的設計語言；1980 年代離子輔助與離子束濺鍍把膜層密度推近塊材，1990 年代光纖通訊的密集分波多工濾光片把厚度控制推到 0.01% 等級。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~In 1817 Fraunhofer noticed that weathered glass reflects less, and in 1886 Rayleigh explained it with a graded index; in 1935 Alexander Smakula at Zeiss patented vacuum-evaporated antireflection coatings, and in 1946 Max Auwärter founded Balzers in Liechtenstein, turning vacuum coating into an industry. Angus Macleod's Thin-Film Optical Filters of 1969 established the characteristic-matrix and admittance-diagram design language; in the 1980s ion assistance and ion-beam sputtering pushed film density toward bulk, and in the 1990s dense-wavelength-division-multiplexing filters for fibre communication drove thickness control to the 0.01% level. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
